1.original: Jude has tasked you with crafting aetherial amplifiers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Minimum collectability rating for this delivery is 150. Delivering items with a rating of 320 or more will earn greater rewards.

2.original: You deliver the aetherial amplifiers to Jude. The chocobo in his breast has transformed into a mighty hobgoblin, and, thus emboldened, he would gladly have your company again once the time is right.

48.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, let us jump straight into the next part of the process!

49.original: I ask that you would craft another vital part of the starlens.

50.original: You see, the operation of this particular type of telescope requires highly specialized magic.

51.original: While I understand the mechanics behind this magic, the sheer volume required far surpasses that at my disposal.

52.original: Please, might you be so kind as to craft aetherial amplifiers for me?

53.original: There are no words to express how thankful I am, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Not only are you assisting me with producing the starlens, but you continue to encourage me every step of the way!

55.original: With the aetherial amplifiers, I should finally be able to channel enough magic to operate our starlens!

58.original: I've just finished looking over the last delivery. We are so close to having all the parts necessary to begin assembly!

59.original: Jude, today must be your lucky day─the ever-busy Jeromere has decided to grace you with his presence!

60.original: Wh-Who are these people!? No doubt they're here to extort coin from me! I must report them to the Studium's guard posthaste!

62.original: You need not worry. They are with me. In fact, they are members of the poetry group I mentioned. I brought them here so everyone could get acquainted.

63.original: It's nice to meet you, Jude!

65.original: Of course she's speaking to you. That is, of course, the reason we are here, is it not?

66.original: Ah, you must be the crafts<hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> assisting Jude. Do also feel free to drop in on one of our poetry meets sometime, should it strike your fancy!

67.original: So what do you think? A magnificent group of people, are they not? We were just on our way to the Last Stand─would you care to join us?

68.original: Steady now. Jeromere is trying to help you. He knows you have no friends, and is attempting to coax you out of your shell. You really should be thankful...truly.

70.original: Apologies, but I am currently in the middle of producing something known as a starlens. Perhaps another time...

72.original: Come now, Jude. Join us just this one time. Only regret awaits, should you continue down this dark path.

73.original: How can you say that with such certainty?

75.original: Trust me, he knows exactly what he's talking about!

76.original: Please, that's enough. L-Let us just be on our way, shall we?

77.original: <sigh> Having to meet new people is quite draining... I must say, however, I'm rather proud of myself. Normally, I would have been so nervous, even the thought of speaking would cause me to lose consciousness! I must be growing.

82.original: It is you I have to thank, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Your continued support has allowed me to really blossom.

84.original: ...Did I just speak up for myself? It seems I have changed even more than I initially thought since meeting <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>.

85.original: I see! It was a test. No doubt <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> was trying to see just how much I have grown!

86.original: Now enough about me! We are so close to the finish line. With just a bit more work, the starlens will be complete!

87.original: Before we proceed, however, there is one thing I must confirm.

88.original: Please come back to see me when you next find the time.

89.original: Thanks to <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, the chocobo in my heart has transformed into a mighty goblin!

90.original: Jude is overjoyed with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Good-natured Individual<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

91.original: A new quest continuing the story of the Faculty of Astronomy is now available.
